# Second Generation - Book Specification

## Overview

**Title:** Second Generation  
**Genre:** Political hard-science Mars novel  
**Word Count Target:** 140,000 - 180,000 words
**This is the second book in Mars Generations series**
**Chapters:** 66 chapters across 6 parts

## Core Questions

**Book One asked:** Can humans survive long enough on Mars to become continuous?

**Book Two asks:** Can a Martian civilization govern itself when Earth returns not as rescuer, but as owner?
